about: The telegraph kit (docs/team/hook/H1_combat_teeth.md item 3): named blows any zone casts on a foe with one call (Battle.Tell, logic/Sim/Tells.cs). Each number is described in logic/Content/Telegraphs.cs. Damage is a fraction of her max life (before her armor), so it is the same at every tier but for the waves' tierDamage (H6). The kind names (ring, charge, pull, closing) are H3's sound bank's keys: telegraph.<kind>.windup / .land. Never rename them. Round 2 (H1, 3 Nov; 128 nights a bot, tier 1): a caught tell now bites 46/37/58% (ring/charge/pull) and the ring roots 1 s, so before the boss the careless hands' lowest life drops to a median 0.39 (0.53 before) and the human's to 0.44 (0.61), while the deft hands' stay put; careless falls 22%, human 15%, deft wins 98%. H6 (4 Nov, the owner after demo-rc2: standing in the marks did not kill): ring 0.70, a caught charge knocks her down 0.9 s, a pull is a drag (0.35) then a slam on its heart 0.7 s later (0.45), a closing is a wall but for its gap and crushes her inside it (0.38 a second from 0.8 s after it lands, for 3 s), every kit damage x tierDamage by tier, and the kit starts at minute 0.75.

waves.about: Where the arena's table nights cast the kit (logic/Play/Zones/ArenaRun.cs): only at these tiers, past this minute of the night, never on a story night or while the boss is up.
